in place of “alignment” which is impersonal and abstract id like to propose a new key dimension of model performance: Fidelity: how well does a model act on your behalf to accomplish your ends and show you the pieces of information relevant to you to make decisions. A high fidelity model acts as an extra sense organ and limb for YOU on your work etc. A model doesn’t get to be high fidelity if it scores well on SWE bench. Only if it provably works well on YOUR work. imo a large part of the problem with swarms and our ability to monitor and control them is that models are currently low fidelity for this use case: I can’t be confident they would notice what I would notice if I looked at a swarm trace, and I can’t be confident they would do what I would do. rather than measuring hiw close a mode is to replacing you, measuring models on fidelity measures how well they HELP you do a job better high fidelity models are the future of models that allow humans to do better work

Agent swarms are going to be a core part of many enterprise workflows in the future. The ability to throw compute at problems that you can massively parallelize will be too useful to not take advantage of. Cyber will be one of the biggest beneficiaries of this as it’s a space where testing vast number of permutations of attacks (without getting tired or bored) is an incredibly useful property. You have a wide search space of possible risk vectors and you generally need to be able to chain together different scenarios to achieve the exploit. This will become one of the biggest token uses in large enterprises given the range of IT systems, software, physical infrastructure, and data that needs to be protected at all times. Super interesting times in cyber.

headline: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background
abstract: One of the core promises of AI is that the more it knows about a person, the better it will be able to assist them with tasks and make appropriate suggestions, which, if you’ll believe the tech companies, requires apps and devices to listen, watch, or record users’ activity all the time and gather all possible context.
